name: Nazara Technologies

snapshot.about: Nazara Technologies is a global gaming platform operator spanning mobile, PC, console, and offline gaming businesses.

narrative: Management targeted gaming margins above 20% and offline margins of 25% to 35%, matching Q2 FY27 gaming margin at 21.5% and Q1 FY27 offline margin at 33%. However, reported performance diverged in Q1 FY27 with a net loss of ₹82 crore.

promises.statement: Core gaming margins are targeted to rise beyond 20%.

said.quote: Eventually, the margin should rise to beyond 20% is what we are working towards

actual_source.quote: EBITDA grew 114% to INR 141 crores, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 21.5%

promises.note: Gaming segment EBITDA margin reached 21.5% in Q2 FY27, surpassing the 20% target.

promises.statement: Offline business steady-state EBITDA margin targeted between 25% and 35%.

said.quote: I think on a steady state, what I said earlier, between 25% to 35% is where we should land up at

actual_source.quote: Offline gaming delivered healthy profitability at a 33% EBITDA margin, with Q1 FY27 revenue of INR 34 crores and EBITDA of INR 11 crores

promises.note: Offline gaming segment delivered a 33% EBITDA margin in Q1 FY27, meeting the target range.

promises.statement: Total capital commitment across SMAAASH and Funky Monkeys is approximately INR 50 crore.

said.quote: Right now, our overall commitment across these two businesses, including some stake increase in Funky Monkeys, is approximately INR 50 odd crore

promises.statement: Nazara plans to raise approximately $100 million in debt to complete the acquisition balance.

said.quote: So, approximately $100 million is what we are planning to raise as a debt, and balance will be funded through internal accruals

promises.statement: Curve Games expects to launch at least 6 new releases in FY27.

said.quote: We expect to launch at least 6 new releases in this current year, maybe a couple more

promises.statement: Fusebox plans to expand Big Brother to three seasons and launch three new seasons of Love Island in FY27.

said.quote: And we are looking to expand the Big Brother season from one season in the last one year to three seasons in this fiscal year, as well as we are looking to launch Traitors in the current fiscal year

promises.statement: NODWIN is targeting organic revenue growth of 30%+ in FY27.

said.quote: NODWIN is targeting organic growth of 30%+ for FY27 and is progressing towards its IPO readiness

promises.statement: Funky Monkeys plans to open 5 more stores in FY27.

said.quote: Funky Monkeys opened 10 new stores in the last 12 months, with 5 more to open in FY27, and margins improved on record birthday revenues

signals.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹376 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹320 crore.
signals.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

cash.read: Profits reliably turn into cash, as cumulative operating cash flow of ₹376 crore exceeded reported net profit of ₹320 crore over FY22 to FY26.

bull.point: Revenue reached a record ₹803 crore in Q2 FY27, up 53% year-on-year, while EBITDA grew 93% to ₹120 crore.

evidence.quote: Revenue was INR 803 crores, our highest ever, up 53% year-on￾year
EBITDA grew 93% to INR 120 crores and EBITDA margin expanded 311 basis points to 14.9%

bull.point: Gaming segment revenue grew 122% year-on-year to ₹656 crore in Q2 FY27, generating an EBITDA margin of 21.5%.

evidence.quote: In Q2 FY27, our gaming segment revenue grew 122% year-on-year to INR 656 crores
EBITDA grew 114% to INR 141 crores, resulting in an EBITDA margin of 21.5%

bull.point: Operating cash flow reached ₹376 crore over FY22–FY26, fully covering reported cumulative net profits of ₹320 crore.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹376 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹320 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bear.point: Standalone financial statements reflected a massive impairment loss of ₹988.94 crore on associate investment following regulatory prohibition of online money games.

evidence.quote: recognition of impairment loss of ` 98,894 Lakhs on investment in one of the associate company due to prohibition in offering of online money games pursuant to the enactment of the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025

bear.point: Consolidated net loss hit ₹82 crore in Q1 FY27, impacted by associate losses and impairment charges.

evidence.quote: We reported a PAT loss of INR 82 crores, largely attributable to the share of loss from associates and impairment loss

bear.point: Debt of approximately $100 million is planned to be raised to fund the balance of pending acquisitions.

evidence.quote: So, approximately $100 million is what we are planning to raise as a debt, and balance will be funded through internal accruals
